title: Effectiveness of Trauma Therapy Using Prolonged Exposure for Patients With PTSD and a Comorbid Psychotic Disorder
official: How Effective and Safe is Trauma Therapy Using Prolonged Exposure for Patients With PTSD and a Comorbid Psychotic Disorder? Treatment Trauma and Psychosis -TEP
summary: Psychosis patients with comorbid PTSD will be treated with trauma therapy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Presence of a psychotic disorder (F20) or affective disorder with psychotic symptoms(F30) according to DSM-5.
* comorbid post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) according to DSM-5 (CAPS-5 score ≥ 23)
* At least 18 years old
* Good knowledge of the German language
* Willingness to participate in randomisation and trauma-focused therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Changes in neuroleptic or antidepressant therapy within the last 4 weeks (exclusion of drug effects).
* Any substance dependence with continued use other than nicotine and/or caffeine dependence.
* IQ of 70 or less
* Acute suicidality
* Pregnant women
